notes.title: God of Riffs 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 1.0.4 has just been released. This update adds some accessibility features and also lays groundwork for some future features.

[h2]Framework Updates[/h2]
First up, the framework additions - Our audio backend has been overhauled to now support FMOD. While current gameplay is unaffected, this will allow us to support a whole bunch of new, kick-ass audio effects in the future, and especially as we continue work on "Battle for the Metalverse!", our Story Mode.

[h2]Enemy Updates[/h2]
Skulls now have attack animations! They swoop up to take a bite at you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/2d19bba5ee0950785e572a71ee457990777b8cee.gif[/img]

[h2]Accessibility Updates[/h2]
Late last year, we showed the game off at PAX West, and gained a lot of feedback on how to move forward. one of the biggest requests for for some more accessibility features, and we're happy to provide them to help metalheads of all abilities rock out and smash some skulls!

Accessibility features added in this update include:
[list]
[*] Vivid Mode
[*]Height Adjust
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/43324b8f3bf232e744c8ba2cdd69e2e00812d8fd.png[/img]
[h3]Vivid Mode[/h3]
This changes the colors of the enemies and your axes from Red, Blue and Yellow to Orange, Cyan, and White. This can be useful for players with most types of color blindness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/77ec48a89b5654e3afbe4139adb53cc60f5cb987.png[/img]
[h3]Height Adjust[/h3]
At PAX, some people had their kids try and play God of Riffs. While we do recommend limiting the game to players over the age of 13, this did make us realise our game wasn't optimized for shorter players. 
We've added a height adjustment option, so that seated, shorter, or younger players can now dial in a comfortable height for skull-smashing! Try setting it to max while standing up to play as a giant! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/db4d0ebafbb5cca94b3ecc8e77dc329d95485862.png[/img]

As always, thank you for your support! Let us know if you have any questions or thoughts. Look forward to the upcoming audio and story mode updates! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/TFy6bxKtg4]Discord[/url] and follow our [url=https://twitter.com/vyersoft]Twitter[/url] to stay posted!

notes.title: GOD OF RIFFS IS READY TO ROCK!
notes.content:
Hey, Metalheads!

Grab your axes - [b]God of Riffs has finally come out of Early Access on Steam[/b], and we’re ready to ROCK!

In a moment of dire need, the metal gods call out for a fearless champion to embark on a rhythmic journey into the domain of the Lord of Silence. Answer their cries and brave forth to slash skeleton armies to a metal beat and save humanity from a sad, rhythmless afterlife. 

Here’s some of the exciting features we’ve added since the last Early Access update:

[list]
[*] An [b]updated, slicker UI [/b]- for smoother navigation
[*] Massively [b]increased performance[/b] - so you can keep on rockin’
[*] [b]Improved haptics[/b] on Meta Quest controllers - feel the buzz
[*] [b]Tutorial level[/b] to train new players to rock god status!
[*][b] Updated ranking system[/b] incentivising smashing skeletons over precise hit timing (and a leaderboard reset!) - the harder you rock, the more you win
[*][b] 55 total achievements [/b]- so you can start rackin’ them up
[*][b] 6 additional new songs[/b] (10 Total) including: 
[*] The full original soundtrack from BMG
[*] “Lay To Waste” by[b] Frank Klepacki and The Tiberian Sons[/b]
[*] ‘Money Money’ by [b]Shota Nakama, from the latest game by SWERY’s White Owls, ‘The Good Life’![/b]
[/list]


We’ve come a long, long way since we entered Early Access, but just because we’ve hit “1.0” doesn’t mean we’re done.. In fact, it's just the start of the journey for God of Riffs!

Here’s a look at what’s [b]coming soon:[/b]


Battle For the Metalverse - G[b]od Of Riffs’ Story Mode![/b]
[b]Additional tracks [/b]including ‘Fly Away’ by GloryHammer, licensed songs from US and Australian Metal bands and collaborations with indie games!
[b]More original tracks![/b]
[b]Release on Meta Quest App Lab![/b]

As always, if you find any issues with any part of the game, feel free to let us know on our discord, or on twitter @bossmusicgames.

Till next time,
Keep Shredding, And see you in the Metalverse!!

notes.title: God of Riffs UPDATE 0.8.4.1
notes.content:
How was everyone’s holiday? Over at Boss Music Games, we’ve been deep in the early access lab cooking up all sorts of quality of life improvements, tightened hit detection, optimisation progress, TWO new environments, and a [url=https://open.spotify.com/track/7uDKheXw6iYqOMDza50LFZ?si=ada491b78a09401e]BRAND NEW TRACK[/url]! 

If you haven’t dived into [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578110]God Of Riffs[/url] recently, build 0.8.4.1 is the release you’ve been waiting for! 


[h2]NEW SONG - WONDERING[/h2]

[url=https://open.spotify.com/track/7uDKheXw6iYqOMDza50LFZ?si=69afe384e47c4efa&nd=1][img]https://i.scdn.co/image/ab67616d00001e026771deb71773c896bbbaf19e[/img][/url]


[h2]WINTER'S EDGE[/h2]

Travel to the mountains of Winter’s Edge. Rock out to our latest exclusive original track! Imagine feeling the cold wind blowing against your skin as you slay hell spawn to the beat of WONDERING - a brand new track! Bask in the GLORY of your victory as you ascend to the throne of the Lord of Silence where he awaits you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/cd62f8fab7c2e3ce6a1e8659728a653fc465d779.png[/img]

[h2]THE CAVERN[/h2]

Snow-capped peaks and a blistering new track not enough? WE AGREE.

If you’re not a snowy person perhaps somewhere dark and dank is more your speed. Delve deep into the Cavern and fight without fear against the mighty ophidian, Deathstroke, who defends the Lord of Silence’s Treasure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/f0074e3c304b81ac49ea581819a7100faadead15.png[/img]

Over the coming months we’ll be adding new tracks, polishes, and content options as we ramp up to our official 1.0 release. We have some big challenges ahead, including adding some exciting new features and nailing down an optimised build for Meta Quest. We expect this will cost us many sleepless nights (it has already), but WE WILL PREVAIL! 

The last few months have been about making the game FEEL right. We’ve made huge strides -  but we’d love to hear what you think. 

Swing over to our [url=https://discord.gg/zsCD9ks8EM]DISCORD[/url] to let us know what you think about the new song, environments, and feel! We’ll be sharing our favourite metal tracks, giving away some keys to share with your friends, sharing sneak peaks of upcoming content, and rocking out with all our fellow headbangers!

notes.title: God Of Riffs 0.8.3.1
notes.content:
Hey, Metalheads!

This is a small update to fix a few bugs, and implement some long awaited backend and framework-level updates to support some upcoming major game features coming in the Upcoming 0.8.4 major patch.


Changelog:

[list]
[*] Updated our base VR framework to OpenXR, allowing for much faster development cycles as we no longer have to juggle multiple XR rigs for each platform
[*] A bunch of UI Tweaks and updates, such as fixes for Song Previews, and some Tweaks to button borders and Leaderboard entry text
[*] Weapon Calibration should be far more stable
[*] Pausing has been reworked, and now detects Input from the Standard Menu Button, System menu button, and Proximity Sensor input! (Please note: Proximity sensor support does not currently work on Vive/Index, we're working on a solution for this, and it should hopefully be in by 0.8.4)
[*] Graphics Performance optimization across the board, allowing play on lower-end devices
[*] Some minor Graphics tweaks in gameplay as we tune in our final look
[/list]

As always, If you have any issues with the game, Bugs to report, want to share a particularly hype session, or just want to chill with us, we're available on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/7D2qgD4vde]Discord[/url], or our [url=twitter.com/bossmusicgames]Twitter![/url]

notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who's joined the journey so far, and provided their feedback!
We've taken all of it into account, and have spent the last week squashing most, if not all of the most egregious bugs. :)


[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Collision Detection reworked - If you're still missing notes, that's on you! :)

[*] Loading screens should be (Mostly) Aligned now, no more loading bars off to the left

[/list]


As always, if you find any issues with any part of the game, feel free to let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/Yvcs5mEqWn]Discord Server[/url], or on Twitter [url=http://twitter.com/bossmusicgames]@bossmusicgames[/url].

notes.title: God of Riffs Blog: Gameplay Features
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Skeleton Slashers!

We're just [b]ONE WEEK [/b]away from the release of [i]God of Riffs[/i] on July 27th! Wow![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/310981b9a3f3fb19905cc5d69bbe127ab6da8cff.png[/img]

We're really excited to get the game into your hands and get your feedback. One of the things that we're excited about, and plan to continue iterating on, is making sure the gameplay mechanics feel [i]"right"[/i] when playing GoR. Below are some of our thoughts detailing the gameplay features and mechanics of God of Riffs. Let's get to it.

[h2]Modifiers:[/h2]
Before selecting your track to slay, you can select from a variety of modifiers that will affect your gameplay. These include:
[list]
[*] [b]No Fail[/b] (Invincibility)
[*] [b]Instant Death[/b] (One miss, and you're dead)
[*] [b]Strong Arms[/b] (Your swings require less force)
[*] [b]Weak Arms[/b] (Your swings require more force)
[*] [b]Hidden Enemies[/b] (Enemies will only appear when they are near)
[*] [b]Random Enemies[/b] (Enemies will switch up their attack formations)
[*] [b]Change Enemy Speed[/b] (Your enemies will come at you at a speed of your choosing)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/3ffb93971944805c8b4f132f97617bb1acf37842.jpg[/img]

We plan on adding more modifiers in the future! Are there any special requests you'd like to see? We're all ears. 👂👂👂👂👂👂

[h2]Combo System:[/h2]

Slashing Skeletons without missing deserves a reward. Along with your streak, you'll contribute to your combo multiplier, which will help you climb up the leaderboards.

[h2]Enemy Colors:[/h2]

Your enemies will come at you in a variety of three colors: [b]Red, Blue, and Gold.[/b] Smash enemies with your axe(s) of their corresponding color to destroy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/b7a5b83da8ccf84a57198bd39896ea52a63ccaff.png[/img]

The Gold enemies however, can be hit with both axes. Hitting a Gold enemy will supercharge your axes and, when the time is right, you can execute Rage Mode!

[h2]Rage Mode/Power Up:[/h2]

To execute Rage Mode, hit Golden Enemies with your axes. After hitting enough of them, raise an Axe to the kky and press the trigger button!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/3029a68e604e2d2e64e30616cbf536e1426e0742.gif[/img]

Rage mode causes your swings to be 8x more forceful than normal, and add 8 to your current combo multiplier! Use Rage during large enemy attacks to gain as many points as possible!

[h2]Spectator Mode:[/h2]

We have full support for LIV Mixed Reality Capture, meaning you can smash skeletons with your own personal avatar, or even as yourself in Mixed Reality!  Grab LIV on Steam or at [url=liv.tv]LIV.tv[/url]! Wahoo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/2b9c1538a8f04a9d2ed2e775c0c35f5aab1a0cc2.png[/img]

[h2]The Future:[/h2]
We have many more ideas planned for how GoR will evolve as we get your feedback and move to version 1.0 (and beyond!) potentially including…:
[list]
[*] Played-Created Beatmaps for any audio
[*] More enemies! Maybe something a little, cold…
[*] More Base-game music!
[*] DLC Song Packs!
[*] Story Mode!
[*] Endless Mode!
[/list]
[i]God of Riffs [/i]will be available in just days, so please check out and wishlist us at [url=heavymetalbeatsaber.com]heavymetalbeatsaber.com[/url] - Thanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/a711b13833394c808e4988420a7eaf0c9e57ced2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Introducing God of Riffs!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/0257115bdde72ae7d1f9f76dac8ed20241458da2.png[/img]

[h1]What’s crankin’, metalheads?[/h1]

Pleasure to meet ya, we’re VYERSOFT and Boss Music Games! We are made up of active VR gamers and enthusiasts, looking to contribute some games to the revolutionary platform of Virtual Reality.

We wanted to quickly say hi with this introductory post and also let you know about a game we’re publishing called God of Riffs, developed by Boss Music Games.

[h3]God of Riffs is a tribute to one of the last true passionate forms of music.. [i]heavy friggin’ metal[/i].[/h3]

There’s no stairway to heaven for the God of Riffs. Instead, you must wield musical battle axes to thrash, smash, and slash incoming hellspawn in rhythmic melee combat fueled by screaming guitar solos and thunderous double bass pedals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/d47c77b76f2270a4739d6631ced5ca550d7f1ae8.gif[/img]
[h3]Starting on July 27th, for $4.99...[/h3]

Slay swarms of undead skeletons — with fearsome ice giants, trolls, and more joining the armies of hell throughout Early Access — or face a dreary, metal-less afterlife.

[h1]About VYERSOFT
[/h1]
VYERSOFT Corp. is a new publisher made up of game industry veterans who have worked on titles such as 2064: Read Only Memories, DAMN! and ToeJam and Earl: Back in the Groove! The team believes in bringing new unique gaming experiences using emerging technologies as a new, innovative medium.

[h1]About Boss Music Games[/h1]

Boss Music Games is a group of crazy blokes that had the totally reasonable idea of starting an indie dev studio. Straight out of school…with limited funds…during a pandemic…from a city no one has heard of (Perth, by the way!). But through the power of persistence and the spirit of metal, they plan to rock the world with their VR projects.
